en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

It's probably just me, but the outside
air always feels so refreshing.

Composing isn't my specialty, but I feel like
I can compose a relaxing song right now.

Running, huh?
I guess it's good to do that sometimes.

But I get tired pretty quickly, so please
go easy on me.

If you leave me behind, then I won't
teach you any piano! Got that?

Huh?
Then why did we come outside?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
